↩️ Returned Goods

Record a customer returning a sealed bottle, accessory, or bale — with or without their receipt. An item returned in good condition goes straight back into stock; damaged items don't. Refills aren't returnable — they're poured straight into the customer's own container. Exchanges are preferred and cash is never refunded — a cheaper replacement always shows KES 0.00 due, with any difference held as store credit rather than paid out.

What's happening to this item?

Top-Up (optional)

If the customer is paying extra — for an upgrade, or to have the item fixed — record it here. It's added to today's revenue like any other payment.

Return Credit

What the returned item is worth toward the exchange. Defaults to its current selling price × quantity — adjust if the agreed credit is different.

🏨 Business Details

The shop name appears in the header, at the top of every receipt and bill, and on printed reports. Changing it here updates it on every device that syncs with this shop.

🖼️ Auto Product Images

When you add a new item or service with no photo of your own, this fetches a stock photo of it automatically — only while the device is online, and only ever a fallback (your own uploaded/captured photo always wins if you add one). Uses Pixabay's free image API — get a free key at pixabay.com (Account → API).

✅ Auto product images are on.

📸 AI Capture List

Powers the "📸 Capture List" button on Add New Items and Restock — photograph or upload an invoice, handwritten note, or delivery sheet, and it reads out item names, quantities, and costs automatically, even with no column headers. Works out of the box using the platform's shared Gemini key pool — hitting its limits often, or want your own quota? Add up to 2 of your own free Google Gemini API keys below; this device tries those first, in order, before falling back to the platform pool.

✅ AI Capture List is available.

🔔 Alert Notifications

Get a notification on this device when an item runs low or nears its expiry date — instead of only finding out when you open the 🔔 bell menu. Each item is announced once per day. This is a per-device setting: turn it on wherever you want to be alerted.

Off.

On iPhone/iPad this only works once the app is installed to the home screen (⚙️ Settings → 📱 Install App).

🚚 Delivery Zones

Set up a fee per zone so the cashier can just pick one at checkout instead of typing a fee every time — e.g. CBD at KES 0 (free), Outside CBD starting from KES 50. The fee can still be typed in manually for anything unusual. Also set a Standard Delivery Cost per zone — your actual operational cost (rider, fuel) to deliver there — used to pre-fill the expense logged automatically when "Free Delivery Applied" is used at checkout.

🛵 Delivery Agents

A unified list the Sales Counter picks from when assigning a delivery. Internal staff become Delivery Agents by ticking "🚚 Deliveries" under their allowed tabs in 👥 Staff Accounts — same as any other role. External riders/couriers (not on payroll, no login) are registered here instead.

Only the main branch can turn this on/off or edit these settings while it's on. When off (the default), every branch keeps its own separate logo, contact details, and paper size.

🔗 Receipt settings are managed centrally by the main branch right now — these fields are read-only here.

💳 Bill Payment Details

Shown on printed bills for customers who pay later — e.g. your Paybill/Till number and phone number. One line per detail.

📝 Receipt Notes

Extra lines printed at the bottom of every receipt and bill — e.g. "Terms and conditions apply" or "Goods once sold are not refundable." One line per statement.

🖼️ Shop Logo

Shown next to the business name in the header on every device, and — if the toggle below is on — printed at the top of every receipt and bill. Any PNG/JPG works; it's shrunk automatically, so a large file is fine. Thermal printers are black-and-white: a bold, high-contrast logo prints far better than a pale or detailed one.

No logo uploaded yet.

📇 Shop Contact Details

Printed right below the logo and business name, at the very top of every receipt and bill.

🔳 QR Code on Receipts

Printed at the bottom of every receipt and bill — e.g. your M-Pesa Paybill QR, your menu, your Google review link, or your socials. Upload the QR image itself (generate it wherever you like, then save the picture here). Keep it chunky: small, dense QR codes don't survive thermal printing.

📐 Item List Alignment

How the item list, totals, and payment lines are laid out on the receipt. The shop name/contact details at the top and the thank-you/notes at the bottom always stay centred, whatever's chosen here. Preview it with any past sale from 📊 Daily Sales → Reprint.

Justified is the standard receipt table layout (item name on the left, price on the right, both edges flush). Left/Center/Right instead group each line compactly and position it at that edge. Applies to the system print dialog, the on-screen receipt, and Bluetooth/USB thermal printers alike.

📐 Receipt Size (System Print)

Sets the paper size the system print dialog uses automatically, so you don't have to set it there every time. Applies to the system print dialog only — Bluetooth/USB thermal printers use their own fixed roll width.

Most thermal printers cut automatically once the receipt is done — Auto is right for almost everyone. Only use Fixed length for pre-cut label stock or a printer that doesn't auto-cut.

Shrinks or enlarges everything on the receipt — useful if text is running slightly off the edge of your paper, or you want it more compact.

🎁 Promotional Offers

Set up discounts that apply automatically as items are added to the cart in the Sales Counter — Buy X Get Y Free, percentage off, a flat KES amount off, or bundle/tiered pricing. Each offer can target the whole inventory or specific products/categories. Only one per-item offer applies per line (the best one) — flat cart-wide offers can stack on top.

🖨️ Receipt Printer

Works with whichever printer mode is selected below. With "System print dialog", the dialog still opens once — this just removes the extra "Print" tap. For it to be fully silent too, launch Chrome with the --kiosk-printing flag (desktop only). With Bluetooth/USB, it prints straight away with no dialog at all.

Applies to every receipt and bill, on every printer. With "System print dialog" all copies go out as one job (one page per copy) — set the dialog's own copy count to 1 so you don't double up. With Bluetooth/USB they print back-to-back automatically.

Not connected.

Once connected, every receipt, bill, and printed report (Expenses, Restock, Sales Report) goes straight to this printer — no system print dialog.

Not connected.

Works with most generic USB thermal receipt printers, straight from the browser — no driver and no print dialog. If it doesn’t show up in the chooser, your printer likely needs a driver and won’t work over WebUSB; use "System print dialog" instead. Needs to be reconnected once per browser session. On Windows, if connecting fails with "Access denied," Windows already has a driver holding the printer exclusively — install Zadig, use it to replace that printer's driver with "WinUSB," then reconnect here.

With this on and this browser tab open, a phone with no printer of its own can send its receipts here instead of showing its own print dialog — useful if only this computer has a printer physically connected. Turns off automatically if the printer disconnects.

📷 Barcode Scanner

No pairing needed here — nearly all barcode scanners (USB or Bluetooth) act as a keyboard: they "type" the code and press Enter automatically. Just plug it in (or pair it as a Bluetooth keyboard in your device's Bluetooth settings), then scan.

  • On the 🛒 Sales Counter tab: scanning adds the item straight to the cart, from anywhere on the page.
  • On the 📦 Add New Items tab: scanning fills in the barcode, and looks up the product name automatically if it's a recognized product. If the item is already in your inventory, its existing details load so you can edit them.

Waiting for a scan...

🗄️ Cash Drawer

Cash drawers plug into the receipt printer itself (an RJ11/RJ12 port on the back), not into the computer directly — the printer sends it the "kick open" signal. Bluetooth and USB printer modes trigger this directly. "System print dialog" mode can now trigger it too, but only if your printer's driver is set to raw/"Generic / Text Only" mode (most thermal receipt printer drivers can be) — the kick command rides along inside the printed receipt itself. If your drawer doesn't open in that mode, switch the printer's driver to Generic / Text Only, or use Bluetooth/USB instead for guaranteed support.

🍳 Kitchen Order Tickets

When a sale includes one or more services, print a plain no-prices ticket for the kitchen — item names and quantities only, in large bold text. Uses the same printer as receipts (system dialog, or a connected Bluetooth/USB printer).

With "System print dialog", this opens a second print job right after the receipt's — expect two dialogs per sale. With Bluetooth/USB it just prints straight after the receipt with no extra tap.

📷 Camera Barcode Scanner

Uses this device's own camera as a barcode scanner — no separate scanner hardware needed. Once enabled, it runs silently in the background: nothing shown on screen, no camera preview, no button to press. Point the item's barcode at the camera anywhere a scan is accepted — Sales Counter, Add New Items, Restock, Contracts — and it behaves exactly like a normal handheld/USB scanner would. Works on Android (phone or a handheld POS terminal) and macOS; not supported on Windows/Linux desktop browsers.

Off.

🖥️ Customer / Pole Display

Shows only the running total on a small second screen facing the customer — no login, no other app screens reachable from it. Open it once on this device, drag its window onto the second screen, then press F11 there to go full-screen. It updates live as items are added, and briefly shows the amount tendered and change once a sale completes.

Works with any small monitor or tablet browser connected to (or mirroring) this device — it's just this same app opened to a second window, not special hardware.

📟 VFD Pole Display (hardware, e.g. Posiflex PD-2600 series, or generic/OEM units)

A real 2-line character display, connected by USB, rather than a second screen — writes the running total (and the amount tendered / change once a sale completes) straight to it, same moments the software display above updates. Connect it once, from this button — after that, it's detected and used automatically every time: on every app open, and even if it's unplugged and replugged while the app stays running. Chrome or Edge on desktop only.

Not connected.

These displays support several named modes (ADM, AEDEX, Epson, Futaba, Noritake, UTC), switched on the unit itself — usually a small DIP switch bank or an on-device menu. The two options above cover the two families those all fall into; tap Test after switching to see which one your unit actually needs. If neither shows correctly, check the unit's own switches/menu for its current mode.

Neither mode worked? Try raw bytes

If your display's manual or model number search turns up its exact command bytes (or a similar unit's), enter the initialize/clear command here as hex, space-separated (e.g. 1B 40 for Epson's ESC @, or 1B 52 40 for some ADM-family units) — text and a line break get sent the same way either mode does, so it's really just this one opening sequence that differs. Whatever works, tell me the bytes and I'll add it as a proper preset.

Option C — KCB Buni

The same M-Pesa STK Push prompt, sent through KCB's bank-direct API instead of Safaricom's own Daraja.

Before this Consumer Key can move real money, KCB requires a one-time production-approval step: email buni@kcbgroup.com (or your KCB Relationship Manager) with your Application Name, this Consumer Key, your Till Number, and your callback URL (shown further down under Option B). This app can't do that step for you.

✅ Payment configured — KCB Buni is live for this shop.

Removes every saved KCB credential. STK prompts will stop working via KCB until they're entered again.

KCB's callback uses the exact same format as Daraja's — no separate callback URL needed, the one shown above under Option B covers this too.

📥 Catch payments made straight to your KCB account, Vooma Till, or Lipa Na KCB till — via KCB's Instant Payment Notification (IPN) service. Unlike Daraja above, this can't be registered automatically — email buni@kcbgroup.com with your account/Till number and the URL below to get it switched on for production.

Option D — Paywave Express

A hosted service that sends the same M-Pesa STK Push prompt for you — just an API key and your account email, no Daraja app or certificates of your own needed. Sign up and get your key at paywavexpress.co.ke (subscription required to activate, from KES 400/month).

📥 Direct Till Payments

Customers who paid straight to your Till/Paybill/KCB account themselves — no prompt from this app — captured automatically once Daraja's Register Till URLs (above) or KCB's IPN (above) is set up. Paystack and Paywave Express don't have an equivalent since they always send the prompt themselves.

🧾 eTIMS (KRA Tax Compliance)

Registers this shop with KRA's electronic tax invoicing system (eTIMS/OSCU). Requires KRA to have already approved this PIN for eTIMS system-to-system (OSCU) access on their own portal — this page can't skip that step, it only performs the one-time device registration once KRA's side is ready.

Checking configuration...

✅ Registered with KRA

ON: every completed sale is submitted to KRA and its receipt shows the CU Invoice Number, Receipt Number, Internal Data, Receipt Signature, SDC date/time, and a VAT-by-rate breakdown. OFF: receipts print as a plain, non-fiscalized sales receipt (items, subtotal, tax, payment, total) with nothing sent to KRA — useful while testing, or if this device shouldn't be the one submitting to KRA.

Only needed if this was registered against the wrong PIN or branch. This shop's receipts will stop showing eTIMS information until it's registered again.

🎟️ Loyalty Tokens

Reward customers with tokens based on how much a single sale comes to — set your own spend brackets and how many tokens each earns. Only applies to sales with a customer phone on file (see 👤 My Customers), and only to sales that are actually paid, not "Pay Later" bills until they're settled.

e.g. spending KES 1,000–2,000 earns 5 tokens, 2,001–3,000 earns 8 — add as many brackets as you like. Leave "Up to" blank for no upper limit on that bracket.

📥 Business Data Import

Upload a single spreadsheet — even a messy day-sheet with stock, debts, and expenses all mixed together on one tab, no clean headers required — and this reads it with AI, sorts the rows into Stock, Debts, and Expenses, and shows you everything before anything is saved. Stock rows update existing items (matched by name) or add new ones; debts land in the 📒 Debts tab; expenses land in Profits & Expenses.

Recognizes an ITEM/SKU/RETAIL/OPEN/BP-style stock table, a "DEBTS" section (customer name next to a balance owed), and an "EXPENSES" section — in any layout, any order, with or without headers.

🗄️ Daily Backups

A snapshot of everything (inventory, sales, staff, settings — the whole shop) is taken automatically once a day, the first time any device syncs, before that day's changes are saved. Kept for 30 days. Use this if a bad sync or a mistake wipes out something important and you need to go back to an earlier day.

Tap "Refresh List" to check for available backups.

Restoring replaces EVERYTHING currently on every device with that day's snapshot — requires the management password, and the current state is itself saved as a safety copy first, just in case.

🗑️ Reset Inventory

Permanently removes every product AND raw material currently in Inventory, on every device. Sales history, customers, staff, and settings are not touched. A daily backup snapshot exists before this runs (see 🗄️ Backups above) in case it's a mistake.

🧾 Delete Voided Sales Records

A voided sale or bill is normally kept (struck-through) as an audit trail rather than deleted. This permanently ERASES every already-voided sale and bill instead of just hiding them, freeing up the list but also breaking that audit trail for good. Only sales/bills already marked voided are affected — nothing currently active is touched.

🔄 Reset App (Factory Reset)

Wipes this link back to a brand-new install — products, tank level, sales, bookings, customers, staff, passwords, and every setting are all cleared on every device sharing this link. Only the Business Name and Admin/Owner Name are kept, so the link itself still opens to the same station identity, just empty. Separately-saved integrations (Payment Gateway, SMS) live outside this and are NOT cleared — turn those off individually in their own Settings sections first if you want those gone too. This cannot be undone — there is no backup restore that brings this back once it's run.

🔒 Lock Tabs

Check any tab to require the management password before it can be opened. The Sales Counter can never be locked. Whenever a staff member is checked in as "serving," every other tab is locked automatically regardless of these checkboxes — these settings only apply when no one is checked in.

Unchecking a locked tab will ask for the management password one last time to confirm.

Require the management password to remove an item from the sales cart.

💳 How do I get M-Pesa payments actually working?

You need one of two options, set up under ⚙️ Settings → 💳 Payment Gateway:

Option A — Paystack (simplest). Get a secret key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) from your Paystack dashboard, paste it into "Save Paystack Key", and copy the Webhook URL shown underneath into Paystack Dashboard → Settings → API Keys & Webhooks. That's it — no Safaricom app needed.

Option B — Safaricom Daraja directly. Needs a Daraja app (Consumer Key/Secret), your Paybill or Till Number, and your Lipa Na M-Pesa Passkey. Use "Till Number" as the transaction type if you take payments on a Till, "Paybill" otherwise. The Callback URL is sent automatically with every request — you only need to copy it somewhere if Safaricom specifically asks you to pre-register one.

Once saved, the key/credential boxes disappear and are replaced with a green "✅ Payment configured" notice — that's confirmation it saved, not a sign something's hidden from you. There's no way to view a saved key again afterwards (this is deliberate, for security); to change it, use Reset to clear it and enter the new one.

If both Paystack and Daraja are configured at once, Paystack is used by default — force one specifically with the "Force a specific provider" dropdown at the bottom of that page.

🖨️ Which printer mode should I use, and why won't copies/the drawer work?

System print dialog works with any printer already installed on the device (via USB, network, or Windows/Mac driver) — no pairing needed, but it opens a print preview each time. Bluetooth and USB modes connect directly to a thermal receipt printer and print silently with no dialog at all, once paired/connected in this same Hardware settings page.

Multiple copies: set the number under "Number of Copies Printed per Receipt" — with System mode, all copies go out as ONE print job (one page per copy), so leave your printer driver's own copy count at 1 or you'll get double the copies you expect.

Cash drawer: it's the printer, not the computer, that triggers the drawer — it plugs into an RJ11/RJ12 port on the back of the printer. Bluetooth/USB modes trigger it directly. System dialog mode can too, but only if the printer's driver is set to "Generic / Text Only" (raw) mode — most thermal printer drivers support this in their settings.

Kitchen tickets use whichever printer mode is already selected here — there's currently no support for sending receipts and kitchen tickets to two different physical printers from the same device.

🖨️ How do I stop the print dialog from popping up every time?

No website or installed app — this one included — is allowed to print silently on its own. Browsers require a confirmation dialog every time; that's a security rule the browser enforces, not something any app's own code can switch off. Installing MinimartPOS to the home screen doesn't change this either.

Two real ways around it:

Bluetooth or USB thermal printer (Settings → Hardware) — these never open a dialog at all, since they send print data straight to the printer instead of going through the browser's print system. If you have a compatible thermal printer, this is the real fix.

Launch the browser with the --kiosk-printing flag — the standard trick for silent printing to a normal (non-thermal) printer via System dialog mode. Step by step:

  1. Set the printer you want to use as the Windows default printer first — Windows Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Printers & scanners → click it → Set as default. Kiosk-printing always uses whichever printer is currently default; there's no prompt to pick a different one.
  2. Close every open Chrome/Edge window — the flag only applies the next time the browser launches, not to a window that's already open.
  3. Find the shortcut that installing AquaPOS created (usually the Desktop, or Start Menu → right-click AquaPOS → "Open file location").
  4. Right-click that shortcut → Properties.
  5. Click into the Target field and go to the very end of the existing text.
  6. Type one space, then --kiosk-printing exactly (two dashes, no space inside it). It should now end with something like: ...--app-id=xxxxxxxx --kiosk-printing
  7. Click Apply, then OK.
  8. Double-click that same shortcut to reopen AquaPOS. Printing now goes straight to the default printer with no dialog, every time.

To get the dialog back later (e.g. to pick a different printer once), remove --kiosk-printing from the Target field the same way.

📦🛠️ What's the difference between an Item and a Service?

Item — something sold exactly as it is: a bag of rice, a bar of soap. Has its own stock count and shows up in the Sales Counter.

Service — something you charge for without selling a physical unit: key cutting, delivery, installation. A plain service just has a flat price. Tick "Made from components" to link it to a bill of materials instead: add each item it uses and how much one sale uses (fractions like 1/2 work here), and the app then works out cost-per-sale and how many you can currently do from stock automatically. Tick "This is a bundle" instead to sell several items/services together (e.g. Paint + Brush + Roller) at one price — bundle components can be picked from existing stock (so their own stock is deducted correctly when it sells) or typed freely for something with nothing to track. A service is either component-based or a bundle, never both.

e.g. "Buy 5 Get 1 Free" = Buy 5, Get 1, 100%. "Buy 3 Get 1 at 50% Off" = Buy 3, Get 1, 50%.
